## What

The `configure-claude-plugins` reference stanza keyed `extraKnownMarketplaces` as `claude-plugins`. `/plugin marketplace add`, the marketplace `name` and this repo's own `.claude/settings.json` all use `laurigates-claude-plugins`. Per the [`extraKnownMarketplaces` reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#extraknownmarketplaces), Claude Code "registers each marketplace it doesn't already know". So on a machine that already had the marketplace, the template registered the same repo a second time under the other key, and the new `enabledPlugins` entries pointed at that copy. The duplicate registration is my inference from that sentence; I didn't observe it.

## Changes

- `references/settings-json.md`, `references/exhaustive-mode.md`, SKILL.md step 3: the key is `laurigates-claude-plugins`, so `enabledPlugins` and workflow `plugins:` share one suffix. The two-suffix callout from #1337 becomes "one suffix, by design", and both inline annotations the existing check requires are kept.
- When merging into a file that uses the old key, the skill renames the key and all its suffixes together.
- `references/workflow-templates.md`: the comments that called the two suffixes distinct now say they are the same value.
- `scripts/plugin-compliance-check.sh`: a new assertion fails if `references/settings-json.md` contains a `"claude-plugins":` key or an `@claude-plugins"` suffix. It is recorded as a new row in `docs/regression-ledger.md`.

## Verification

- `bash scripts/plugin-compliance-check.sh configure-plugin` exits 0 with no `configure-claude-plugins` findings.
- With `origin/main`'s `settings-json.md` restored, the same run exits 1 with `must key the marketplace as "laurigates-claude-plugins"`. The fixed file was then put back.
- SKILL.md is 9,850 characters, under the 10,000 advisory threshold. A first draft of the note went over it and was shortened.
- `rg '@claude-plugins\b|"claude-plugins"\s*:'` finds no other occurrences in the repo, apart from the migration note and the comfyui README fixed in a separate PR. An earlier `git grep -E` search returned nothing because macOS git grep doesn't support `\b`.

## Not in this PR

Five local repos are still configured with the old key and suffix: `ForumViriumHelsinki/.github`, `pal-mcp-server`, `local-ai-testing`, `mcu-tinkering-lab` and `truenas-ai-sentinel`. Each is self-consistent, so their plugins load, but each registers the marketplace a second time on a machine that already has it.
